title: dumpsys meminfo 输出字段解读：PSS/RSS/USS
key_conclusions: PSS is the best first-line process cost metric because shared pages are proportionally charged, while RSS can double-count shared pages and USS/private dirty better estimates process-private reclaim.

dumpsys meminfo buckets are attribution entry points, not final proof; Java Heap needs HPROF/MAT/LeakCanary, Native Heap needs heapprofd or malloc evidence, and Graphics needs buffer or SurfaceFlinger evidence.
Allocation recording from Day 26 must be reconciled with meminfo before/after totals so churn, peak, retained Java objects, native memory, graphics buffers, SQL, and fd growth are not mixed together.
A fix should be accepted only when the relevant meminfo bucket and the external owner evidence both improve under the same replay scenario.
shallow_points: The article does not include a real dumpsys meminfo capture from a device or compare Android version/vendor ROM formatting differences.
It explains PSS/RSS/USS conceptually but does not validate exact calculations against libmeminfo source for a target Android branch.
It does not include an automated parser that extracts before/after bucket deltas into a report.
It does not correlate a real meminfo sample with a same-run HPROF, heapprofd trace, dmabuf dump, and fd snapshot.
discovered_connections: Day 26 allocation evidence becomes more useful when mapped to Java Heap, Native Heap, Graphics, SQL, Objects, and Total PSS deltas.
Day 24 and Day 25 MAT retained-path work explains only Java Heap retained ownership, so native, graphics, SQL, and fd buckets require separate tools.
Day 20 resource-lifetime evidence maps naturally to SQL, Objects, and fd changes in meminfo.
Day 28 should expand from per-process meminfo to system-wide procrank/showmap comparisons and shared-page accounting.
Later dma-buf, bitmap, and low-memory articles should reuse PSS/RSS/USS boundaries instead of treating one process bucket as the whole system pressure story.

Day 32 should deepen /proc/<pid>/maps and smaps attribution for native mappings, ashmem, memfd, file mappings, and anonymous memory.

Need target-branch validation for Debug.MemoryInfo, MemInfoReader, and libmeminfo PSS/RSS/private dirty calculation paths.

Need a small parser and budget report for before/after meminfo validation.
